Keep the entire card outline, exact “Custom-mapped attributes” title, full Directory Sync description, and “Add attributes” gradient button. Keep white surfaces, the official Lighthouse gradient only on the primary button, and no tint colors or glow.

Exact title and description preserved; Add attributes uses the official gradient on a white card with no tint.
